de.name: Symbolische Schnelligkeit
de.description: 36...60 Sekunden lang verwenden alle Eure Siegel Euer Attribut Schnellwirkung statt der normalen Attribute.
de.concise: (36...60 Sekunden.) Eure Siegel verwenden das Attribut Schnellwirkung.

en.name: Symbolic Celerity
en.description: For 36...60 seconds, all of your signets use your Fast Casting attribute instead of their normal attributes.
en.concise: (36...60 seconds.) Your signets use your Fast Casting attribute.
